1.1.text:
I. GENERAL
Every citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence. Acts of violence constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity. The State has the obligation to provide protection and a sense of security to its citizens in accordance with the Pancasila philosophy and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
Women and children are often victims of acts of violence both within the scope of the household and society. The Government through Law of the Republic of Indonesia Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence and Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection has provided protection that favors women and children as groups vulnerable to violence. The implementation of protection for women and children from acts of violence in the City of Ternate requires legal instruments in order to run effectively with the fulfillment of the rights of victims and involving community participation.

Article 7
Every person who sees, hears or knows of the occurrence of violence against women and children is obligated to prevent the occurrence of violence, provide protection to victims of violence and assist in the process of submitting an application for protection.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Ternate.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor, and Regional Apparatus as elements of the administration of the Regional Government of the City of Ternate.
3. Regional Head is the Mayor of Ternate.
4. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years including a child still in the womb.
5. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
6. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death.
7. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
8. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
9. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
10. Service is an action that must be immediately provided to the victim when seeing, hearing, and knowing of the occurrence, the ongoing occurrence, or the having occurred of violence against the victim.
11. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
12. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in a Hospital managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico legal) psycho-social and legal services.
13. Safe house is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and or community organizations.
15. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife or husband, wife and their child or father and his child and mother and her child, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
17. Household is family members and relatives (grandchildren, nieces/nephews, older siblings, younger siblings, grandfathers, grandmothers, cousins or other designations) and non-relatives (servants, drivers or other designations) who are present and reside in one house).
18. Administration is the form of implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence.
19. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions or other parties.
20. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of forum for women's empowerment and child protection based on the community in efforts to fulfill information and needs in the fields of education, health, economy, politics, law, protection and prevention of acts of violence and trafficking against women and children.

Article 3
The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to provide protection and services to women and children victims of violence based on gender and the best interests of the child, occurring in households and in public.

Article 8
(1) The implementation of protection for victims is carried out in an integrated manner within the Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children (P2TP2A).
(2) P2TP2A of Ternate City may receive case referrals from stakeholders within the territory of Ternate City.
(3) Protection for women and children victims of violence is provided to residents of Ternate City whether it occurs in Ternate City or outside Ternate City.
(4) The establishment and further provisions regarding P2TP2A shall be further regulated by Regulation and/or Decree of the Regional Head.

Article 5
In the event of violence, every victim has the right to receive protection and assistance both psychologically and legally, and to receive guarantees of their rights related to their status as a family member as well as a member of society.

CHAPTER VII
SANCTION PROVISIONS
Article 13
(1) Every person who intentionally fails to provide protection to women and children resulting in the occurrence of violence, allows violence to occur, and or does not report and does not provide protection to victims, shall be subject to sanctions as regulated in the applicable laws and regulations.
(2) If officials appointed to provide protection do not carry out their obligations and responsibilities, they shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.
(3) P2TP2A managers who carry out service duties that violate service principles may be subject to sanctions in accordance with P2TP2A internal mechanisms.

CHAPTER VI
ASSISTANCE
Article 12
Assistance is carried out by persons or institutions that have expertise to conduct counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence, in cooperation with P2TP2A.

Article 4
What is meant by receiving protection is receiving protection from individuals, groups or institutions, both Government and non-Government.
What is meant by receiving information is receiving information about the location of complaint services, PPT, and matters related to the fulfillment of their rights and being involved in every decision-making process related to assistance and developments in case handling.
What is meant by integrated services is services that include medical, medico-legal, psychosocial and legal.
What is meant by continuous handling is handling that does not only stop at physical and psychological recovery, but until the victim can resume their life in society including restoration of their good name.

Article 10
The provision of protection to victims shall be carried out free of charge, swiftly, safely, with empathy, non-discriminatorily, easily accessible and with a guarantee of confidentiality.

Article 2
Letter a Respect for the rights of victims is intended to guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of victims.
Letter b Sufficiently clear.
Letter c What is meant by gender justice is a condition where women and men have equal status and the same fundamental rights.
What is meant by gender equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in public, economic, social and cultural activities, national defense and security and equality in enjoying the results of such development.
Letter d Non-discrimination is an attitude and treatment toward victims by not making distinctions based on race, ethnicity, religion and class.
Letter e What is meant by the best interests of victims is that all actions taken to protect victims are solely aimed at providing the best conditions for victims

CHAPTER III
RIGHTS OF VICTIMS
Article 4
Every victim has the right to obtain protection, information, integrated services, continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage and confidential handling from individuals, groups or government institutions as well as the community.

GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Ternate.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor, and Regional Apparatus as elements of the administration of the Regional Government of the City of Ternate.
3. Regional Head is the Mayor of Ternate.
4. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years including a child still in the womb.
5. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
6. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death.
7. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
8. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
9. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
10. Service is an action that must be immediately provided to the victim when seeing, hearing, and knowing of the occurrence, the ongoing occurrence, or the having occurred of violence against the victim.
11. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
12. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in a Hospital managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico legal) psycho-social and legal services.
13. Safe house is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and or community organizations.
15. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife or husband, wife and their child or father and his child and mother and her child, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
17. Household is family members and relatives (grandchildren, nieces/nephews, older siblings, younger siblings, grandfathers, grandmothers, cousins or other designations) and non-relatives (servants, drivers or other designations) who are present and reside in one house).
18. Administration is the form of implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence.
19. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions or other parties.
20. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of forum for women's empowerment and child protection based on the community in efforts to fulfill information and needs in the fields of education, health, economy, politics, law, protection and prevention of acts of violence and trafficking against women and children.

Article 3

I. GENERAL
Every citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence. Acts of violence constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity. The State has the obligation to provide protection and a sense of security to its citizens in accordance with the Pancasila philosophy and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
Women and children are often victims of acts of violence both within the scope of the household and society. The Government through Law of the Republic of Indonesia Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence and Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection has provided protection that favors women and children as groups vulnerable to violence. The implementation of protection for women and children from acts of violence in the City of Ternate requires legal instruments in order to run effectively with the fulfillment of the rights of victims and involving community participation.

SANCTION PROVISIONS
Article 13
(1) Every person who intentionally fails to provide protection to women and children resulting in the occurrence of violence, allows violence to occur, and or does not report and does not provide protection to victims, shall be subject to sanctions as regulated in the applicable laws and regulations.
(2) If officials appointed to provide protection do not carry out their obligations and responsibilities, they shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.
(3) P2TP2A managers who carry out service duties that violate service principles may be subject to sanctions in accordance with P2TP2A internal mechanisms.

Article 5

Letter a Respect for the rights of victims is intended to guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of victims.

Letter e What is meant by the best interests of victims is that all actions taken to protect victims are solely aimed at providing the best conditions for victims

(1) The implementation of protection for victims is carried out in an integrated manner within the Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children (P2TP2A).

1. Region is the City of Ternate.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor, and Regional Apparatus as elements of the administration of the Regional Government of the City of Ternate.
3. Regional Head is the Mayor of Ternate.
4. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years including a child still in the womb.
5. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
6. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death.
7. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
8. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
9. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
10. Service is an action that must be immediately provided to the victim when seeing, hearing, and knowing of the occurrence, the ongoing occurrence, or the having occurred of violence against the victim.
11. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
12. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in a Hospital managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico legal) psycho-social and legal services.
13. Safe house is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and or community organizations.
15. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife or husband, wife and their child or father and his child and mother and her child, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
17. Household is family members and relatives (grandchildren, nieces/nephews, older siblings, younger siblings, grandfathers, grandmothers, cousins or other designations) and non-relatives (servants, drivers or other designations) who are present and reside in one house).
18. Administration is the form of implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence.
19. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions or other parties.
20. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of forum for women's empowerment and child protection based on the community in efforts to fulfill information and needs in the fields of education, health, economy, politics, law, protection and prevention of acts of violence and trafficking against women and children.

Article 3
The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to provide protection and services to women and children victims of violence based on gender and the best interests of the child, occurring in households and in public.

CHAPTER VII
SANCTION PROVISIONS
Article 13
(1) Every person who intentionally fails to provide protection to women and children resulting in the occurrence of violence, allows violence to occur, and or does not report and does not provide protection to victims, shall be subject to sanctions as regulated in the applicable laws and regulations.
(2) If officials appointed to provide protection do not carry out their obligations and responsibilities, they shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.
(3) P2TP2A managers who carry out service duties that violate service principles may be subject to sanctions in accordance with P2TP2A internal mechanisms.

Article 2
Letter a Respect for the rights of victims is intended to guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of victims.
Letter b Sufficiently clear.
Letter c What is meant by gender justice is a condition where women and men have equal status and the same fundamental rights.
What is meant by gender equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in public, economic, social and cultural activities, national defense and security and equality in enjoying the results of such development.
Letter d Non-discrimination is an attitude and treatment toward victims by not making distinctions based on race, ethnicity, religion and class.
Letter e What is meant by the best interests of victims is that all actions taken to protect victims are solely aimed at providing the best conditions for victims

I. GENERAL
Every citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence. Acts of violence constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity. The State has the obligation to provide protection and a sense of security to its citizens in accordance with the Pancasila philosophy and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
Women and children are often victims of acts of violence both within the scope of the household and society. The Government through Law of the Republic of Indonesia Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence and Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection has provided protection that favors women and children as groups vulnerable to violence. The implementation of protection for women and children from acts of violence in the City of Ternate requires legal instruments in order to run effectively with the fulfillment of the rights of victims and involving community participation.

Article 8
(1) The implementation of protection for victims is carried out in an integrated manner within the Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children (P2TP2A).
(2) P2TP2A of Ternate City may receive case referrals from stakeholders within the territory of Ternate City.
(3) Protection for women and children victims of violence is provided to residents of Ternate City whether it occurs in Ternate City or outside Ternate City.
(4) The establishment and further provisions regarding P2TP2A shall be further regulated by Regulation and/or Decree of the Regional Head.

Article 10
The provision of protection to victims shall be carried out free of charge, swiftly, safely, with empathy, non-discriminatorily, easily accessible and with a guarantee of confidentiality.

Article 5
In the event of violence, every victim has the right to receive protection and assistance both psychologically and legally, and to receive guarantees of their rights related to their status as a family member as well as a member of society.

CHAPTER III
RIGHTS OF VICTIMS
Article 4
Every victim has the right to obtain protection, information, integrated services, continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage and confidential handling from individuals, groups or government institutions as well as the community.

Article 4
What is meant by receiving protection is receiving protection from individuals, groups or institutions, both Government and non-Government.
What is meant by receiving information is receiving information about the location of complaint services, PPT, and matters related to the fulfillment of their rights and being involved in every decision-making process related to assistance and developments in case handling.
What is meant by integrated services is services that include medical, medico-legal, psychosocial and legal.
What is meant by continuous handling is handling that does not only stop at physical and psychological recovery, but until the victim can resume their life in society including restoration of their good name.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Ternate.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor, and Regional Apparatus as elements of the administration of the Regional Government of the City of Ternate.
3. Regional Head is the Mayor of Ternate.
4. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years including a child still in the womb.
5. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
6. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death.
7. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
8. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
9. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
10. Service is an action that must be immediately provided to the victim when seeing, hearing, and knowing of the occurrence, the ongoing occurrence, or the having occurred of violence against the victim.
11. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
12. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in a Hospital managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico legal) psycho-social and legal services.
13. Safe house is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and or community organizations.
15. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife or husband, wife and their child or father and his child and mother and her child, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
17. Household is family members and relatives (grandchildren, nieces/nephews, older siblings, younger siblings, grandfathers, grandmothers, cousins or other designations) and non-relatives (servants, drivers or other designations) who are present and reside in one house).
18. Administration is the form of implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence.
19. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions or other parties.
20. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of forum for women's empowerment and child protection based on the community in efforts to fulfill information and needs in the fields of education, health, economy, politics, law, protection and prevention of acts of violence and trafficking against women and children.

Article 4
What is meant by receiving protection is receiving protection from individuals, groups or institutions, both Government and non-Government.
What is meant by receiving information is receiving information about the location of complaint services, PPT, and matters related to the fulfillment of their rights and being involved in every decision-making process related to assistance and developments in case handling.
What is meant by integrated services is services that include medical, medico-legal, psychosocial and legal.
What is meant by continuous handling is handling that does not only stop at physical and psychological recovery, but until the victim can resume their life in society including restoration of their good name.

CHAPTER VI
ASSISTANCE
Article 12
Assistance is carried out by persons or institutions that have expertise to conduct counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence, in cooperation with P2TP2A.

Article 8
(1) The implementation of protection for victims is carried out in an integrated manner within the Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children (P2TP2A).
(2) P2TP2A of Ternate City may receive case referrals from stakeholders within the territory of Ternate City.
(3) Protection for women and children victims of violence is provided to residents of Ternate City whether it occurs in Ternate City or outside Ternate City.
(4) The establishment and further provisions regarding P2TP2A shall be further regulated by Regulation and/or Decree of the Regional Head.

Article 5
In the event of violence, every victim has the right to receive protection and assistance both psychologically and legally, and to receive guarantees of their rights related to their status as a family member as well as a member of society.

CHAPTER III
RIGHTS OF VICTIMS
Article 4
Every victim has the right to obtain protection, information, integrated services, continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage and confidential handling from individuals, groups or government institutions as well as the community.

I. GENERAL
Every citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence. Acts of violence constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity. The State has the obligation to provide protection and a sense of security to its citizens in accordance with the Pancasila philosophy and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
Women and children are often victims of acts of violence both within the scope of the household and society. The Government through Law of the Republic of Indonesia Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence and Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection has provided protection that favors women and children as groups vulnerable to violence. The implementation of protection for women and children from acts of violence in the City of Ternate requires legal instruments in order to run effectively with the fulfillment of the rights of victims and involving community participation.

Article 3
The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to provide protection and services to women and children victims of violence based on gender and the best interests of the child, occurring in households and in public.

Third Part
Principles of Service

Article 10
The provision of protection to victims shall be carried out free of charge, swiftly, safely, with empathy, non-discriminatorily, easily accessible and with a guarantee of confidentiality.

Second Part
Types of Services

Article 2
Letter a Respect for the rights of victims is intended to guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of victims.
Letter b Sufficiently clear.
Letter c What is meant by gender justice is a condition where women and men have equal status and the same fundamental rights.
What is meant by gender equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in public, economic, social and cultural activities, national defense and security and equality in enjoying the results of such development.
Letter d Non-discrimination is an attitude and treatment toward victims by not making distinctions based on race, ethnicity, religion and class.
Letter e What is meant by the best interests of victims is that all actions taken to protect victims are solely aimed at providing the best conditions for victims

Article 7
Every person who sees, hears or knows of the occurrence of violence against women and children is obligated to prevent the occurrence of violence, provide protection to victims of violence and assist in the process of submitting an application for protection.

CHAPTER VII
SANCTION PROVISIONS
Article 13
(1) Every person who intentionally fails to provide protection to women and children resulting in the occurrence of violence, allows violence to occur, and or does not report and does not provide protection to victims, shall be subject to sanctions as regulated in the applicable laws and regulations.
(2) If officials appointed to provide protection do not carry out their obligations and responsibilities, they shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.
(3) P2TP2A managers who carry out service duties that violate service principles may be subject to sanctions in accordance with P2TP2A internal mechanisms.
